execution.title: Implementation plan

execution.recommended_course: Settle the tax on SGD 250,000.00 interest from Marlow Holdings Limited to Marlow Capital Pte. Ltd. at the lowest amount the facts support. Conservative tax: SGD 42,500.00 (Singapore income tax SGD 42,500.00).

course_parts.conservative: Conservative tax: SGD 42,500.00 (Singapore income tax SGD 42,500.00).

phases.title: Establish the facts behind each payment
Settle the treatments that move the tax

treatment_paths.title: This strategy's path
treatment_paths.when: The guaranteed tax of this strategy, with its rulings taken as the list says. Verify the liability and actual payments before filing.

execution.summary: Complete the tax treatment and compliance work for the recorded transactions.
execution.comparison: The recorded arrangement is retained. Alternative structures were not compared; this plan implements and resolves the entered transactions. Scope: income tax only; VAT, GST, stamp duty, customs duty and property taxes are not assessed. This window shows strategy #1 of the list; the other strategies are the alternatives.

steps.title: Prepare the financing and interest file
steps.why: The conservative tax on this payment is Singapore income tax SGD 42,500.00; every later step relies on these facts.
steps.owner: Marlow Capital Pte. Ltd. finance, with Marlow Holdings Limited finance
steps.action: Marlow Holdings Limited pays Marlow Capital Pte. Ltd. SGD 250,000.00 for interest on 2026-12-31. Match the interest to the borrowing period, loan purpose, rate and contractual allocation of withholding tax.
documents: Use of funds and lender details
Interest benchmark and related-party pricing support
steps.completion: A reconciled transaction workpaper with the supporting documents and a named reviewer.

steps.title: Obtain the facts answered Unknown
steps.why: Unknown facts are taken at their least favourable value, so they hold the conservative estimate up until a supported answer replaces them.
steps.action: Obtain supporting records for: annual taxable income outside the case's flows (may be negative: the company's own loss; decision D51); whether the Singapore foreign tax credit pooling election is made; the source jurisdiction's statutory corporate income tax rate for resident enterprises; not a withholding, treaty or non-resident rate. Until supported answers are entered and reassessed, keep these facts Unknown and retain the conservative treatment.
steps.completion: Each available fact has a reviewed source and the assessment is rerun; unavailable facts remain explicitly Unknown.

steps.title: Resolve the outstanding tax treatment
steps.why: Decides whether the expense was incurred in the production of assessable profits. On its own it does not lower the conservative estimate; it matters together with the other open treatments.
steps.owner: Marlow Holdings Limited tax lead and tax adviser
steps.action: Prepare a supported position on: whether the expense was incurred in the production of assessable profits. Record the conclusion and any authority response.
documents: evidence of the purpose of the expense
Written treatment analysis and any relevant authority correspondence
steps.completion: A reviewed treatment memo with evidence; any required authority acceptance is recorded separately.

steps.title: Confirm the Hong Kong position
steps.why: No Hong Kong tax on the conservative basis. If the open treatments are supported, SGD -41,250.00 arises here (Hong Kong income tax SGD -41,250.00).
steps.owner: Marlow Holdings Limited finance and local tax adviser
steps.action: Reconcile the transaction income, costs, taxes and any credit with the local accounts and actual payment evidence. Use the conservative position for unresolved treatment; verify credit entitlement separately from proof that tax was paid.
documents: Transaction tax workpaper and local return
Foreign tax assessment and receipts, if a credit is claimed
steps.completion: The local return position, reserve and any permitted credit are approved by the responsible reviewer.

steps.title: Settle the Singapore tax: SGD 42,500.00
steps.why: Conservative Singapore tax: Singapore income tax SGD 42,500.00.
steps.owner: Marlow Capital Pte. Ltd. finance and local tax adviser
steps.action: Reconcile the transaction income, costs, taxes and any credit with the local accounts and actual payment evidence. Use the conservative position for unresolved treatment; verify credit entitlement separately from proof that tax was paid.
documents: Transaction tax workpaper and local return
Foreign tax assessment and receipts, if a credit is claimed
steps.completion: The local return position, reserve and any permitted credit are approved by the responsible reviewer.

steps.title: Approve the workpack and keep the audit trail
steps.why: Closes the plan: who decided what, on which evidence, and what remains open.
steps.action: Assign each work item, review the conditional decisions and reserve, and retain contracts, computations, approvals and submission receipts. Rerun the assessment when a material fact or treatment changes.
documents: Filing acknowledgements and payment receipts, where applicable
steps.completion: The responsible reviewer signs the workpack; unresolved treatments and remaining actions are explicitly recorded.

decision_paths.condition: whether the expense was incurred in the production of assessable profits
decision_paths.if_supported: Record the conclusion and reassess; on its own this does not change the conservative estimate.
decision_paths.otherwise: Keep the conservative treatment and its reserve; do not record an unapproved saving.

execution.completion_note: Ready for review means the workpack is generated. It does not mean documents have been approved, filings submitted, taxes paid or authority acceptance obtained.
